flow_ref: User story (not in the flow deck; no OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: The general MHA/LTA address mechanism (Epic OCMS7) exists but is not run for warrant / Letter of Advice defendants (17%).
note: Sinonim dicoba di enam repo (UI dan API): letter of advice, LOA, advice, warrant, WOA, warrant of arrest, mention date, court date, court batch, last known address, work item, dashboard, OIC. Tidak ada maintenance ticket yang cocok (grep warrant / letter of advice / court = 0). Status story kosong di data (requirement tidak diberikan); dilacak biasa. CasIntegrationController (CAS-ke-OCMS, casUpdateCourtNotices) ada tetapi bukan fitur ini dan tidak dikreditkan: ocmsadminapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/apiservice/workflows/cas_integration/CasIntegrationController.java:101. This story points to Epic OCMS7. That mechanism exists (upload IDs to MHA, download the result, save the mha_reg address), but its input selection is limited to stages RD1-DR3 (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/workflows/agencies/mha/upload/helpers/MhaNricDataHelper.java:186-193), so it does not take IDs from the OCMS27.1 identification step (which is also absent). The downloaded address is only Sebagian because it is the general mechanism, not a Letter of Advice flow. Correctness of MHA/DataHive data cannot be verified from the repo.
recommendation: Evidence 17%. Claim only the general address mechanism; do not claim address checks for Letter of Advice defendants.

steps.step: OCMS sends Letter of Advice defendants' IDs to the relevant agencies (MHA/LTA)
steps.detail: The MHA/LTA upload covers only stages RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3 (MHA) and ROV (LtaUploadHelper.java:88); no path feeds warrant / Letter of Advice defendants. cron.mhaupload.enabled=true in cron-schedules-prod.properties:106; the real server value cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS receives the agency result and updates the latest address on the notice
steps.detail: The MHA download reads the result file and saves the mha_reg address into OffenceNoticeAddress (MhaNricDownloadHelper.java:629-630). This is the general Epic OCMS7 mechanism for uploaded notices, not specific to Letter of Advice defendants. cron.mhadownload.enabled=true in cron-schedules-prod.properties:120; MHA file content cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: Letter of Advice is sent to the defendant's latest address
steps.detail: No code creates or sends a Letter of Advice (no 'advice' letter template/type in the six repos). The existing Toppan letter generation is for reminder/DN stages, not Letter of Advice.
